_comment: The updater app's own UI strings in English, matching res/values/strings.xml. The app is runtime-switchable, so a run sets this language before driving the flows.

picker.title: Choose version
picker.progress_confirm: Confirm the install on the TV.
picker._touch_comment: The touch picker only: the row's notes icon (content description) and the overlay it opens. progress_confirm above is the TV wording; a touch device says 'on the device' (values-finger).
picker.select: Select a version to see its release notes.

interval._comment: Settings → Edit check interval…. The picker's live preview reads 'Every 3 days'; the Settings summary reads 'Now every 3 days.'. The unit words are the plural forms the rows and chips show (matched case-insensitively).
interval.title: Check interval

open_prompt._comment: The 'Open Plezy?' offer shown after every successful install (A1).
open_prompt.title: Open Plezy?
open_prompt.message: Plezy {version} is installed. Start it now?
